# Alpha diversity
```{r knitr_options_wild, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width=10, fig.height=7, fig.fullwidth=TRUE,
fig.path='Figures/', warning=FALSE,
message=FALSE)
set.seed(1703)
```

***Metagenomics***
```{r load_data_alpha_metagenomics}
load("resources/metagenomics/data_filtered.Rdata")
treatment_colors <- c("#e5bd5b", "#6b7398", "#76b183", "#d57d2c", "#2a2d26", "#f9d4cc", "#3c634e", "#ea68c3")

sample_metadata <- sample_metadata %>%
  select(1,2,7,8) %>%
  mutate(method="shotgun")
```

```{r alpha_div, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
richness <- genome_counts_filt %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "genome") %>%
  dplyr::select(where( ~ !all(. == 0))) %>%
  hilldiv(., q = 0) %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::rename(richness = 1) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "sample")

neutral <- genome_counts_filt %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "genome") %>%
  dplyr::select(where( ~ !all(. == 0))) %>%
  hilldiv(., q = 1) %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::rename(neutral = 1) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "sample")

phylogenetic <- genome_counts_filt %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "genome") %>%
  dplyr::select(where( ~ !all(. == 0))) %>%
  hilldiv(., q = 1, tree = genome_tree) %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::rename(phylogenetic = 1) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "sample")

dist <- genome_gifts %>%
  to.elements(., GIFT_db) %>%
  traits2dist(., method = "gower")

functional <- genome_counts_filt %>%
  filter(genome %in% rownames(dist)) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "genome") %>%
  dplyr::select(where( ~ !all(. == 0))) %>%
  hilldiv(., q = 1, dist = dist) %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::rename(functional = 1) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "sample") %>%
  mutate(functional = if_else(is.nan(functional), 1, functional))

# Merge all metrics
alpha_div_meta <- richness %>%
  full_join(neutral, by = join_by(sample == sample)) %>%
  full_join(phylogenetic, by = join_by(sample == sample)) %>%
  full_join(functional, by = join_by(sample == sample))
```

```{r alpha_meta_table, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
metagenome_alpha_div <- alpha_div_meta %>%
  select(1:3) %>% 
  left_join(sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == sample))
```

```{r save_alpha_meta, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
saveRDS(metagenome_alpha_div, "resources/metagenomics/metagenome_alpha_div.rds")
```

```{r alpha_div_diets_summary_all_metagenomics, comment="",echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
alpha_div_meta %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample, names_to = "alpha", values_to = "value") %>%
  left_join(sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == sample)) %>%
  group_by(alpha) %>%
  summarise(
    total_mean = mean(value, na.rm = T),
    total_sd = sd(value, na.rm = T),
    Eb_mean = mean(value[Species == "Eb"], na.rm = T),
    Eb_sd = sd(value[Species == "Eb"], na.rm = T),
    Ha_mean = mean(value[Species == "Ha"], na.rm = T),
    Ha_sd = sd(value[Species == "Ha"], na.rm = T),
    Pk_mean = mean(value[Species == "Pk"], na.rm = T),
    Pk_sd = sd(value[Species == "Pk"], na.rm = T)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Total = str_c(round(total_mean, 3), "±", round(total_sd, 3)),
    Eptesicus = str_c(round(Eb_mean, 3), "±", round(Eb_sd, 3)),
    Hypsugo = str_c(round(Ha_mean, 3), "±", round(Ha_sd, 3)),
    Pipistrellus = str_c(round(Pk_mean, 3), "±", round(Pk_sd, 3))
  ) %>%
  arrange(-Eb_mean) %>%
  dplyr::select(alpha, Total, Eptesicus, Pipistrellus, Hypsugo) %>%
  tt()
```

***Amplicon***
```{r div_load_data, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
load("resources/amplicon/data_standard_filt.Rdata")
sample_metadata <- sample_metadata %>%
  select(1,9,10,13) %>%
  mutate(method="amplicon")

no_archaea <- genome_counts_filt %>% 
  left_join(genome_metadata[c(1,2)], by="genome") %>% 
  filter(domain!="Archaea") %>% 
  select(-domain)

```


```{r filter_copy2, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
richness <- genome_counts_filt %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "genome") %>%
  dplyr::select(where( ~ !all(. == 0))) %>%
  hilldiv(., q = 0) %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::rename(richness = 1) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "sample")

neutral <- genome_counts_filt %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "genome") %>%
  dplyr::select(where( ~ !all(. == 0))) %>%
  hilldiv(., q = 1) %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::rename(neutral = 1) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "sample")

amplicon_alpha_div <- richness %>%
  full_join(neutral, by = join_by(sample == sample))
```

```{r alpha_div_diets_summary_all_amplicon, comment="",echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
amplicon_alpha_div %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample, names_to = "alpha", values_to = "value") %>%
  left_join(sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == sample)) %>%
  group_by(alpha) %>%
  summarise(
    total_mean = mean(value, na.rm = T),
    total_sd = sd(value, na.rm = T),
    Eb_mean = mean(value[Species == "Eb"], na.rm = T),
    Eb_sd = sd(value[Species == "Eb"], na.rm = T),
    Ha_mean = mean(value[Species == "Ha"], na.rm = T),
    Ha_sd = sd(value[Species == "Ha"], na.rm = T),
    Pk_mean = mean(value[Species == "Pk"], na.rm = T),
    Pk_sd = sd(value[Species == "Pk"], na.rm = T)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Total = str_c(round(total_mean, 3), "±", round(total_sd, 3)),
    Eptesicus = str_c(round(Eb_mean, 3), "±", round(Eb_sd, 3)),
    Hypsugo = str_c(round(Ha_mean, 3), "±", round(Ha_sd, 3)),
    Pipistrellus = str_c(round(Pk_mean, 3), "±", round(Pk_sd, 3))
  ) %>%
  arrange(-Eb_mean) %>%
  dplyr::select(alpha, Total, Eptesicus, Pipistrellus, Hypsugo) %>%
  tt()
```

```{r alpha_amp_table, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
amplicon_alpha_div_data <- amplicon_alpha_div %>%
  left_join(sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == sample))
```
```{r save_alpha_amp, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
saveRDS(amplicon_alpha_div_data, "resources/amplicon/amplicon_alpha_div.rds")
```

## Comparison

```{r}
join_alpha <- rbind(metagenome_alpha_div,amplicon_alpha_div_data)
```

### Differences between methods and species

***Richness***
```{r rich_MM_ampli_species_general, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
Model_richness <- lm(formula = richness ~ Species*method, data = join_alpha)
anova(Model_richness)
```

***Neutral***
```{r neutral_MM_ampli_species_general, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
Model_neutral <- lm(formula = neutral ~ Species*method, data = join_alpha)
anova(Model_neutral)
```

#### Metagenomic data

***Richness***
```{r rich_MM_general, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
Model_richness <- lm(formula = richness ~ Species, data = metagenome_alpha_div)
anova(Model_richness)
emmeans(Model_richness, pairwise ~ Species)
```

***Neutral***
```{r neutral_MM_general, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
Model_neutral <- lm(formula = neutral ~ Species, data = metagenome_alpha_div)
anova(Model_neutral)
emmeans(Model_neutral, pairwise ~ Species)
```
